name: scdaw_set_automation
description: Set or update continuous parameter automation points (time in beats, value) for a track parameter such as 'volume', 'pan', or 'cutoff'.

points.description: List of automation points { time, value }

value.description: Target parameter value at this time

time.description: Point time in musical beats (when setting a single point)

value.description: Point value (when setting a single point)
